title: A High-Precision Machine Learning Algorithm to Classify Left and Right Outflow Tract Ventricular Tachycardia.
summary: An XGBoost ECG classifier distinguishes left- versus right-ventricular-outflow-tract ventricular tachycardia in 420 retrospective patients; held-out performance and comparison with localization approaches are reported. This is single-center diagnostic support, not clinical outcome evidence.
